summary: Taxshift launched. Every measure was checked against the Acts, Parliament bill pages and ATO guidance as at 20 November 2026.

Now tracking Tax Reform No. 4: an optional 50% CGT discount for start-up investors, narrower electric car FBT exemption and monthly PAYG instalments. It passed the House on 29 October 2026 and is before the Senate.
The Treasurer said the Government has agreed to amend the trusts bill, including on testamentary trusts and distributions to exempt entities. It has not yet passed the Senate.
